principle: A figure the data cannot support is not shown. Absence is declared, not silent.
zone_rule: For each changed file, take the highest-severity zone whose pattern matches it. The change's zone is the highest across all changed files. Patterns use fnmatch semantics; `*` also matches `/`.

risk_zones.why: These files write to user machines (~/.claude/settings.json, launchd agents), publish binaries, instruct agents, or change the rules of review itself.
Network pollers, filesystem ingestion, scan-state integrity, the price data every dollar figure flows through, and the dependency supply chain.
Correctness of displayed numbers. The product is a truthful meter; a wrong dollar figure is worse than no figure.

summary.heading: ## Summary
summary.means: What changes and why, in the contributor's words.

checks.heading: ## Checks
checks.means: A statement that `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`, and `cargo test` pass locally.

behavior.heading: ## Behavior evidence
behavior.means: Proof the change does what it claims: a before/after report sample, a new test, or equivalent.

assumptions.heading: ## External assumptions
assumptions.means: Every belief about data this project does not control (Claude transcript JSONL schema, Codex rollout schema and its rate_limits variants, settings.json keys, the OAuth and wham endpoints, official price cards) and how each was verified against real data. An unverified assumption is missing evidence — declare it here instead of hiding it.

risk.heading: ## Risk
risk.means: What breaks if this change is wrong, and the rollback.

second_review.heading: ## Second review
second_review.means: An adversarial pass by a second agent or human, with its findings and their resolution.

confirmation.checkbox: - [x] I am a human. I read the diff and the evidence above, and I take responsibility for this change.
confirmation.means: Set by the human contributor only. An agent must never check this box.

gates.zone_declared: The PR body names the risk zone and it matches the zone computed from the changed files.
gates.evidence_complete: Every section this zone requires is present in the PR body.
gates.human_confirmed: The confirmation box is checked. Required for high and critical zones.
gates.maintainer_review: GitHub review approval. This gate belongs to the maintainer alone; no tool and no contributor statement can set it.

provenance.disclosure: When an agent produced any part of the change, name the tool and model in the PR body.
provenance.commit_trailer: Keep the agent's Co-Authored-By trailer on commits.
